ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Dominance of low-intensity dark pixels (approx. 85-90%) with scattered high-intensity yellowish-white and medium-intensity grey pixels (approx. 10-15%).
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Widespread distribution of small, high-contrast yellowish punctate spots across both lobes; a significant region of light-grey mottling on the interior right lobe; large, irregular, multi-colored (brown, white, grey) textured masses on both distal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a calculated angle of approximately 45 degrees and a deep vertical indentation relative to the fluke's horizontal axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular and jagged continuous boundary; left lobe shows moderate serration; right lobe and both distal tips exhibit extreme high-amplitude pixel variations and irregular protrusions due to external growth.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense spatial detection of small, roughly circular, high-contrast yellowish pixel clusters distributed across the entire visible ventral surface.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Single prominent, unaligned, light-colored linear pixel disruption visible on the inner lower quadrant of the right lobe, oriented diagonally.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive biological encrustations (barnacle colonies) on the distal tips of both lobes and along the trailing edge of the right lobe, significantly altering the natural geometric contour.
other_distinctive_markers: The yellow-hue intensity of the punctate spotting is highly distinctive compared to standard white pigmentation patterns.
